entity: CMS Order and Referring file (Medicare's ordering eligibility list): recently deactivated clinicians still flagged Y to order DME
why: Only CMS's own methodology names the file, and it states the design (current enrollment only), not a measurement, so it neither matches nor contradicts. Collins/PSI 2008 (DME paid under dead doctors' orders) and OIG 2013 (enrollment data inconsistent) cover the pattern, not this list.
